trailerExcluded.description: The trailer key whose commits are left out.

bucket.description: The bucket size. Months are labelled YYYY-MM, weeks by their Monday, YYYY-MM-DD. Both are UTC.

overall.description: The distribution over the whole window, not an average of the buckets.

buckets.description: Oldest first, from the first bucket holding any change to the one holding the end of the window, with no gaps.

start.description: Start of the bucket. The first and last may extend beyond the window.

logicalChanges.description: Logical changes, leaving out those with a Code-Health trailer.

measured.description: Changes at or under the maximum changeset size: the sample the statistics describe.

singleFile.description: Measured changes of one file, which have spread 0.

oversized.description: Changes over the maximum changeset size, left out of the statistics.

oversizedShare.description: oversized / logicalChanges. Null when there are no changes.

excludedByTrailer.description: Changes left out because the commit carries a Code-Health trailer. Not part of logicalChanges.
